# protocol-http

**Tag**: web, networking

## 简介

Provides abstractions to handle HTTP protocols.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/socketry/protocol-http
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/socketry/protocol-http.git
- 文档: https://socketry.github.io/protocol-http/
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/protocol-http
